header.name: [bedrock-research]inventory-ui-slider-bp_v1.0.0
header.description: v1.0.0 - Sliders drawn in an entity chest screen. A tap slider sends each tap as a slot button, and a release slider shows its value on screen while dragging and sends it on release through hidden global step buttons. The server drops a tap that comes in the tick the drag value changed. Works next to the other entity inventory examples. Use the Inventory UI Slider item from the creative inventory.
